summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting to signed-in account  ### What I found before proposing anything I read the full path first, since "fix the auth-adjacent bug" without knowing what's actually broken is how you make it worse. Findings:  - **Backend (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`)**: every route requires a valid session (401 if not), sets `X-User-Id` from the session, and every query filters by `watchlists.user_id = userId` (list, get, put, delete, add item, remove item). No anonymous fallback, no default/guest id. - **Schema (`modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, `db/push.ts`)
